[RSS 2024]: Expressive Whole-Body Control for Humanoid Robots

Expressive Whole-Body Control for Humanoid Robots Xuxin Cheng* · Yandong Ji* · Junming Chen Ge Yang · Xiaolong Wang Website | arXiv | Video | Summary ## Installation ## Next install fbx. Follow the instructions [here](https://github.com/nv-tlabs/ASE/issues/61). ## Prepare dataset 1. Download from [here](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1m3JRBox51cjV4CbiKIcVXR6eKQBjaAhO/view?usp=sharing) and extract the zip file to `ASE/ase/poselib/data/cmu_fbx_all` that contains all `.fbx` files. 2. Gnerate `.yaml` file for the motions you want to use. This step is not mandatory because the `.yaml` file is already generated. But if you want to add more motions, you can use this script to generate the `.yaml` file. 3. Import motions This will import all motions in CMU Mocap dataset into `ASE/ase/poselib/data/npy`. 4. Retarget motions This will retarget all motions in `ASE/ase/poselib/data/npy` to `ASE/ase/poselib/data/retarget_npy`. 5. Gnerate keybody positions This step will require running simulation to extract more precise key body positions. Train for 1 iteration and kill the program to have a dummy model to load. It is recommended to use `motions_autogen_all.yaml` at the first time, so that later if you have a subset it is not neccessary to regenerate keybody positions. This will generate keybody positions to `ASE/ase/poselib/data/retarget_npy`. Set wandb asset: ## Usage To train a new policy `xxx-xx` is usually an id like `000-01`. `motion_type` and `motion_name` are defined in `legged_gym/legged_gym/envs/h1/h1_mimic_config.py`. They can be also given as arguments. Can set default WANDB_ENTITY in `legged_gym/legged_gym/utils/helpers.py`. To play a policy No need to write the full experimentt id. The parser will auto match runs with first 6 strings (xxx-xx). So better make sure you don't reuse xxx-xx. Delay is added after 8k iters. If you want to play after 8k, add `--delay`. >[!abstract] 一句话总结：将 CMU 人体动捕数据经过 FBX 解析、重定向（retarget）、关键身体点提取后构造参考动作，在仿真中用强化学习训练策略（legged_gym/ASE 框架，H1 人形配置），并通过域随机化与延迟建模实现零样本 sim-to-real 的全身动作模仿控制。


# 一、动机

> 人形机器人的全身控制多聚焦于稳定行走等任务导向行为，缺乏对丰富、富有表现力（expressive）全身动作的生成与复现能力，且从仿真到真实硬件的零样本迁移仍很困难。


# 二、方法

> 将 CMU 人体动捕数据经过 FBX 解析、重定向（retarget）、关键身体点提取后构造参考动作，在仿真中用强化学习训练策略（legged_gym/ASE 框架，H1 人形配置），并通过域随机化与延迟建模实现零样本 sim-to-real 的全身动作模仿控制。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 在 Unitree H1 人形机器人上实现了对大量 CMU MoCap 重定向动作（行走、跳舞、挥手等）的零样本真机复现，无需真实数据微调；训练流程中延迟（delay）在 8k 次迭代后加入，以提升真机鲁棒性。具体量化指标（如动作跟踪误差、成功率）请以原文为准。


# 四、对我的启发

> 局限在于策略主要依赖本体感知与参考动作，缺乏视觉/环境感知，动作集受动捕数据与重定向质量约束；启发在于『大规模人体动捕 + 重定向 + RL + 域随机化』是低成本赋予人形机器人丰富全身技能的有效范式，可直接迁移到跨本体动作学习的课题中。
